    bn = b_nodes.get(nid)
    an = a_nodes.get(nid)
    if not bn or not an:
        diffs.append((nid,'missing'))
    elif bn['pixels']!=an['pixels'] or bn['color']!=an['color'] or bn['boundary']!=an['boundary']:
